# CustomHostname

`zones.cloudflare.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1` · Namespaced · [all resources](../README.md)

| Operation | Request |
|---|---|
| observe | `GET /zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames/{custom_hostname_id}` |
| create | `POST /zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames` |
| update | `PATCH /zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames/{custom_hostname_id}` |
| delete | `DELETE /zones/{zone_id}/custom_hostnames/{custom_hostname_id}` |

References: `zoneRef` → Zone.

Credentials: via zone → account.

## Example

```yaml
apiVersion: zones.cloudflare.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1
kind: CustomHostname
metadata:
  name: example
spec:
  forProvider:
    hostname: <hostname>
    zoneRef:
      name: <name>
```
